mapper.sql: ((t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{period}) or (t.task_level='week' and exists(select 1 from lab_task period_parent where period_parent.id=t.parent_id and period_parent.task_level='month' and period_parent.period=#{period} and period_parent.del_flag='0')))
mapper.select: select e.task_id,t.title task_title,e.episode_no,e.block_start_time,t.owner_id recipient_id,'OWNER' audience,null missing_fields,t.period from lab_task_block_event e join lab_task t on t.id=e.task_id and t.del_flag='0' and t.current_block_flag='1' join lab_member owner on owner.id=t.owner_id and owner.member_status='ACTIVE' and owner.del_flag='0' join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner.user_id and owner_user.status='0' and owner_user.del_flag='0' where e.block_status='OPEN' and e.del_flag='0' union all select e.task_id,t.title,e.episode_no,e.block_start_time,manager_member.id,'MANAGER',null,t.period from lab_task_block_event e join lab_task t on t.id=e.task_id and t.del_flag='0' and t.current_block_flag='1' join sys_role manager_role on manager_role.role_key='lab_manager' and manager_role.status='0' and manager_role.del_flag='0' join sys_user_role manager_link on manager_link.role_id=manager_role.role_id join sys_user manager_user on manager_user.user_id=manager_link.user_id and manager_user.status='0' and manager_user.del_flag='0' join lab_member manager_member on manager_member.user_id=manager_user.user_id and manager_member.member_status='ACTIVE' and manager_member.del_flag='0' where e.block_status='OPEN' and e.del_flag='0' order by task_id,episode_no,recipient_id,audience
mapper.sql: (t.plan_date is null or t.deliverable is null or trim(t.deliverable)='' or (t.workflow_status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(t.result_status,'DOING')<>'UNDONE' and (t.actual_finish_time is null or t.result_desc is null or trim(t.result_desc)='' or not exists(select 1 from lab_task_evidence pe where pe.task_id=t.id and pe.del_flag='0'))) or (t.workflow_status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(t.result_status,'DOING')='UNDONE' and (t.fail_reason is null or trim(t.fail_reason)='' or t.next_action is null or trim(t.next_action)='')) or (t.coordination_required='1' and (t.coordination_owner_id is null or t.coordination_dept_id is null or t.coordination_content is null or trim(t.coordination_content)='' or t.coordination_support is null or trim(t.coordination_support)='')))

and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0' and not exists(select 1 from lab_period_close pc where pc.period=#{period} and pc.close_status='CLOSED' and pc.del_flag='0') and
mapper.select: select t.id task_id,t.title task_title,null episode_no,null block_start_time,t.owner_id recipient_id,'OWNER' audience, missing_fields,t.period from lab_task t join lab_member owner on owner.id=t.owner_id and owner.member_status='ACTIVE' and owner.del_flag='0' join sys_user owner_user on owner_user.user_id=owner.user_id and owner_user.status='0' and owner_user.del_flag='0' where union all select t.id,t.title,null,null,manager_member.id,'MANAGER',,t.period from lab_task t join sys_role manager_role on manager_role.role_key='lab_manager' and manager_role.status='0' and manager_role.del_flag='0' join sys_user_role manager_link on manager_link.role_id=manager_role.role_id join sys_user manager_user on manager_user.user_id=manager_link.user_id and manager_user.status='0' and manager_user.del_flag='0' join lab_member manager_member on manager_member.user_id=manager_user.user_id and manager_member.member_status='ACTIVE' and manager_member.del_flag='0' where #{managerEscalation}=true and order by task_id,recipient_id,audience
mapper.update: update lab_reminder set read_flag='1',read_time=#{readTime},update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and recipient_id=#{recipientId} and version=#{version} and read_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
update lab_reminder set read_flag='1',read_time=#{readTime},update_by=#{actor},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where recipient_id=#{recipientId} and read_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
mapper.select:
with weekly_progress as ( select w.parent_id month_task_id, coalesce(round(100*sum(case when w.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and w.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then 1 else 0 end) /nullif(sum(case when w.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' then 1 else 0 end),0),2)/100,0) completion_ratio from lab_task w join lab_task parent_month on parent_month.id=w.parent_id and parent_month.task_level='month' and parent_month.task_type='key' and parent_month.period<=date_format(#{asOf},'%Y-%m') and parent_month.del_flag='0' join lab_goal weekly_annual on weekly_annual.id=parent_month.goal_id and weekly_annual.goal_level='YEAR' and weekly_annual.year=#{year} and weekly_annual.status='ACTIVE' and weekly_annual.del_flag='0' where w.task_level='week' and w.del_flag='0' group by w.parent_id ), month_progress as ( select m.id,m.goal_id,m.milestone_id,m.period,m.plan_date,m.workflow_status,m.result_status, m.goal_weight,q.weight quarter_weight, case when m.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and m.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then 1 when m.workflow_status='ACTIVE' then coalesce(wp.completion_ratio,0) else 0 end completion_ratio from lab_task m join lab_goal a on a.id=m.goal_id and a.goal_level='YEAR' and a.year=#{year} and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.del_flag='0' join lab_goal q on q.id=m.milestone_id and q.parent_id=a.id and q.goal_level='QUARTER' and q.del_flag='0' left join weekly_progress wp on wp.month_task_id=m.id where m.task_level='month' and m.task_type='key' and m.period<=date_format(#{asOf},'%Y-%m') and m.del_flag='0'
), open_blocks as ( select be.task_id,min(be.block_start_time) block_start_time from lab_task_block_event be join lab_task block_task on block_task.id=be.task_id and block_task.del_flag='0' where be.block_status='OPEN' and be.block_start_time<=#{asOf} and be.del_flag='0' group by be.task_id ), goal_expected as ( select mp.goal_id, sum(case when mp.plan_date<=date(#{asOf}) then mp.goal_weight*mp.quarter_weight/100 else 0 end) expected_progress from month_progress mp group by mp.goal_id ), milestone_progress as ( select mp.goal_id,mp.milestone_id,mp.quarter_weight, least(100,greatest(0,round(sum(mp.goal_weight*mp.completion_ratio),2))) milestone_progress from month_progress mp group by mp.goal_id,mp.milestone_id,mp.quarter_weight ), goal_actual as ( select mt.goal_id, least(100,greatest(0,round(sum(mt.quarter_weight*mt.milestone_progress/100),2))) actual_progress from milestone_progress mt group by mt.goal_id ), goal_progress as ( select ge.goal_id,ge.expected_progress,coalesce(ga.actual_progress,0) actual_progress from goal_expected ge left join goal_actual ga on ga.goal_id=ge.goal_id ), goal_risk as ( select rt.goal_id, max(case when blocks.block_start_time is not null then datediff(date(#{asOf}),date(blocks.block_start_time)) else 0 end) max_open_block_days, max(case when rt.task_level='month' and rt.task_type='key' and rt.result_status='DELAYED' then 1 else 0 end) delayed_focus_task, max(case when rt.task_level='month' and rt.task_type='key' and rt.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) and rt.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') then 1 else 0 end) overdue_unsubmitted_focus_task from lab_task rt join lab_goal risk_goal on risk_goal.id=rt.goal_id and risk_goal.goal_level='YEAR' and risk_goal.year=#{year} and risk_goal.status='ACTIVE' and risk_goal.del_flag='0' left join open_blocks blocks on blocks.task_id=rt.id where ((rt.task_level='month' and rt.period<=date_format(#{asOf},'%Y-%m')) or (rt.task_level='week' and exists(select 1 from lab_task risk_parent where risk_parent.id=rt.parent_id and risk_parent.task_level='month' and risk_parent.period<=date_format(#{asOf},'%Y-%m') and risk_parent.del_flag='0'))) and rt.del_flag='0' group by rt.goal_id ) select g.id goal_id,g.title goal_title,g.year, coalesce(max(gp.expected_progress),0) expected_progress, coalesce(max(gp.actual_progress),0) actual_progress, coalesce(max(gr.max_open_block_days),0) max_open_block_days, coalesce(max(gr.delayed_focus_task),0) delayed_focus_task, coalesce(max(gr.overdue_unsubmitted_focus_task),0) overdue_unsubmitted_focus_task from lab_goal g left join goal_progress gp on gp.goal_id=g.id left join goal_risk gr on gr.goal_id=g.id where g.goal_level='YEAR' and g.year=#{year} and g.status='ACTIVE' and g.del_flag='0' group by g.id,g.title,g.year order by g.id

with weekly_progress as ( select w.parent_id month_task_id, coalesce(round(100*sum(case when w.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and w.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then 1 else 0 end) /nullif(sum(case when w.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' then 1 else 0 end),0),2)/100,0) completion_ratio from lab_task w join lab_task parent_month on parent_month.id=w.parent_id and parent_month.task_level='month' and parent_month.task_type='key' and parent_month.period<=date_format(#{asOf},'%Y-%m') and parent_month.del_flag='0' join lab_goal weekly_annual on weekly_annual.id=parent_month.goal_id and weekly_annual.goal_level='YEAR' and weekly_annual.year=#{year} and weekly_annual.status='ACTIVE' and weekly_annual.del_flag='0' where w.task_level='week' and w.del_flag='0' group by w.parent_id ), month_progress as ( select m.goal_id,m.milestone_id,m.period,m.plan_date,m.goal_weight,q.weight quarter_weight, case when m.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and m.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then 1 when m.workflow_status='ACTIVE' then coalesce(wp.completion_ratio,0) else 0 end completion_ratio from lab_task m join lab_goal a on a.id=m.goal_id and a.goal_level='YEAR' and a.year=#{year} and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.del_flag='0' join lab_goal q on q.id=m.milestone_id and q.parent_id=a.id and q.goal_level='QUARTER' and q.del_flag='0' left join weekly_progress wp on wp.month_task_id=m.id where m.task_level='month' and m.task_type='key' and m.period<=date_format(#{asOf},'%Y-%m') and m.del_flag='0'
), periods as ( select distinct goal_id,period from month_progress ), milestones as ( select distinct goal_id,milestone_id,quarter_weight from month_progress ), milestone_trend as ( select p.period,ms.goal_id,ms.milestone_id,ms.quarter_weight, least(100,greatest(0,round(sum(mp.goal_weight*mp.completion_ratio),2))) milestone_progress from periods p join milestones ms on ms.goal_id=p.goal_id left join month_progress mp on mp.goal_id=ms.goal_id and mp.milestone_id=ms.milestone_id and mp.period<=p.period group by p.period,ms.goal_id,ms.milestone_id,ms.quarter_weight ), annual_trend as ( select mt.period,mt.goal_id, least(100,greatest(0,round(sum(mt.quarter_weight*mt.milestone_progress/100),2))) annual_progress from milestone_trend mt group by mt.period,mt.goal_id ), actual_trend as ( select period,goal_id,annual_progress actual_progress from annual_trend ), expected_monthly as ( select mp.goal_id,mp.period, sum(case when mp.plan_date<=date(#{asOf}) then mp.goal_weight*mp.quarter_weight/100 else 0 end) expected_delta from month_progress mp group by mp.goal_id,mp.period ), expected_trend as ( select goal_id,period,round(sum(expected_delta) over(partition by goal_id order by period),2) expected_progress from expected_monthly ) select et.goal_id,g.title goal_name,et.period,et.expected_progress,coalesce(at.actual_progress,0) actual_progress from expected_trend et join lab_goal g on g.id=et.goal_id and g.del_flag='0' left join actual_trend at on at.goal_id=et.goal_id and at.period=et.period order by et.goal_id,et.period

select (select coalesce(round(100*sum(case when t.workflow_status='CONFIRMED' and t.result_status in ('EXCEEDED','ONTIME','DELAYED') then t.perf_weight else 0 end) /nullif(sum(t.perf_weight),0),2),0) from lab_task t where t.period=#{period} and t.task_level='month' and t.task_type='key' and t.del_flag='0' ) key_task_completion_rate, (select count(1) from lab_task t where and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0' and not exists(select 1 from lab_period_close pc where pc.period=#{period} and pc.close_status='CLOSED' and pc.del_flag='0') and (t.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) or ) ) overdue_or_pending_count, (select count(distinct t.id) from lab_task t join lab_task_block_event be on be.task_id=t.id and be.block_status='OPEN' and be.del_flag='0' where and t.current_block_flag='1' and t.del_flag='0' and datediff(date(#{asOf}),date(be.block_start_time))>=7 ) blocked_over_seven_count, (select count(1) from lab_asset a join lab_member asset_owner on asset_owner.id=a.primary_owner_id and asset_owner.del_flag='0' where (a.critical_flag='1' or (a.status='ACTIVE' and a.asset_stage in ('DEPLOYED','ACCEPTED'))) and a.del_flag='0' and (a.backup_owner_id is null or not exists(select 1 from lab_member backup where backup.id=a.backup_owner_id and backup.member_status='ACTIVE' and backup.del_flag='0')) and (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' or (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_lead' and asset_owner.biz_line=#{scope.bizLine}) or (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_member' and a.primary_owner_id=#{scope.memberId}))) assets_without_backup_count
select t.workflow_status code,t.workflow_status name,count(1) item_count from lab_task t where and t.del_flag='0' group by t.workflow_status order by t.workflow_status

select m.id member_id,u.nick_name member_name,m.biz_line, coalesce(sum(case when t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{period} and t.task_type='key' then t.perf_weight else 0 end),0) key_task_weight, sum(case when and t.workflow_status='ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) active_task_count, sum(case when t.task_level='week' and t.plan_date between date(#{twoWeekStart}) and date(#{asOf}) then 1 else 0 end) recent_week_task_count, sum(case when and t.plan_date<date(#{asOf}) and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') then 1 else 0 end) overdue_count, sum(case when and t.current_block_flag='1' then 1 else 0 end) blocked_count, sum(case when and t.coordination_required='1' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') then 1 else 0 end) coordination_count from lab_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' left join lab_task t on t.owner_id=m.id and t.del_flag='0' and ( or (t.task_level='week' and t.plan_date between date(#{twoWeekStart}) and date(#{asOf}))) where m.member_status='ACTIVE' and m.del_flag='0' and m.biz_line=#{scope.bizLine} group by m.id,u.nick_name,m.biz_line order by m.biz_line,m.id

select t.id,'TASK' item_type,t.title,t.workflow_status item_status,t.plan_date due_date from lab_task t where and t.coordination_required='1' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.del_flag='0' order by t.plan_date,t.id limit 50

select ri.id,'REPORT' item_type,ri.report_no title, concat(ri.lifecycle_status,'/',ri.json_status,'/',ri.markdown_status,'/',ri.word_status,'/',ri.pdf_status) item_status,coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) due_date from lab_report_instance ri where ri.period=#{period} and ri.del_flag='0' and (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' or (ri.sensitive_flag='0' and ri.final_flag='1' and ((ri.lifecycle_status='FINAL' and ri.json_status='READY' and ri.markdown_status='READY' and ri.word_status='READY' and ri.pdf_status='READY') or ri.lifecycle_status in ('FINALIZED','SUPERSEDED')))) order by coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) desc,ri.id desc limit 20

select ri.id,'REPORT' item_type,ri.report_no title, concat(ri.lifecycle_status,'/',ri.json_status,'/',ri.markdown_status,'/',ri.word_status,'/',ri.pdf_status) item_status,coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) due_date from lab_report_instance ri where ri.period=#{period} and ri.del_flag='0' and (#{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' or (ri.sensitive_flag='0' and ri.final_flag='1' and ((ri.lifecycle_status='FINAL' and ri.json_status='READY' and ri.markdown_status='READY' and ri.word_status='READY' and ri.pdf_status='READY') or ri.lifecycle_status in ('FINALIZED','SUPERSEDED')))) order by coalesce(ri.update_time,ri.create_time) desc,ri.id desc limit 1

select p.result_status code,p.result_status name,count(1) item_count from lab_perf_score p where p.period=#{period} and p.current_flag='1' and p.del_flag='0' and #{scope.roleKey}='lab_manager' group by p.result_status order by p.result_status

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key='lab_manager' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' join lab_member m on m.user_id=u.user_id and m.member_status='ACTIVE' and m.del_flag='0' where u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' order by u.user_id
